title: Far bank, industry and countryside

sharedRoots.note: Shared native ground/building tile store; keep one runtime copy. Region bounds do not clip merged meshes.

checks: Every selected source index has the recorded name, parent and fingerprint.
Rooms retain room extras, material metadata and street opening markers.
Hidden templates stay hidden until their live game system owns them.
No runtime original GLB, bake sidecar, client URL or Node asset loading.
Render dry/day, rain/night and both sides/below of exposed solid edges.
Test walk spawns with native physics after all shared ground resources are loaded.
Use isolated proof layouts; preserve Rijnkaai authored identities and Steve's saved lamp.
Far bank geometry stays across the river at z below -262; do not assign a walk spawn in water.
Works smoke stays render overlay without solid collision.
Countryside is visual extent and must not cause NPCs to navigate all 2500m of its bounds.

exceptions.feature: Leaf cards, grass/ivy cards and feather quads
exceptions.reason: Thin cutout surfaces have no solid thickness; preserve alpha, wind and double-sided intent.

exceptions.feature: Glazing, hidden/mating join faces and thin roof flashing
exceptions.reason: Do not open watertight joints or make thin sheet thicker with a large bevel.
Intake preserves source geometry. Every exposed silhouette is subject to the AGENTS material-edge review; source preservation is not approval to leave a visibly sharp edge.
Shader/alpha overlay is an effect, not solid geometry with bevels or collision.
